integrity: Exact symbolic reduction and analytic proof; finite reproducibility checks are diagnostic, not the source of completeness. No claims of global publication priority or third-party certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact census covers real primitive two-cycles only for positive gains below 1+2*pi, with no classification of higher periods, global basins or nonlinear dynamics at neutral endpoints. Closely related 2022 lattice paper was available at abstract level only. Independent scientific validation is not available.
title: An exact period-two sink lattice and symmetry-breaking threshold in a sinusoidal planar map
